Off Calendar Aug-31-2009 Judgment Entered
MINI MINUTES: This matter comes on calendar this day, having been assigned from the Presiding Judge Dept. 206 for Court Trial/Settlement Conference. Comm: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, Reporter: Helen Sorep-Matley, CSR 225.

Elizabeth MacDonald, Esq. appeared for plaintiff Capital One Bank (USA), N.A., f/k/a Capital One Bank.
Defendant Neftali Castillo was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Notice of Time & Place of Trial was filed on May 14, 2009.

Settlement agreement reached by the parties was placed on the record by Ms. MacDonald. In accordance with the agreement, the parties stipulate for entry of judgment against defendant Neftali Castillo in the amount of $1,000.00. Commencing October 1, 2009, defendant shall make monthly payments of $25.00 to plaintiff until the balance is paid in full. All payments are due on the 1st of each month. Plaintiff shall not seek any further interest or fees.

Mr. Castillo was voir dired by the Court as to the terms and his understanding of the agreement.

Counsel for plaintiff shall submit the proposed stipulated judgment to the Court no later than September 9, 2009.
